title: LIONSGATE TO RELEASE FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL YEAR EARNINGS FOR FISCAL 2026 AND HOLD ANALYST AND INVESTOR CONFERENCE CALL AFTER MARKET CLOSE ON THURSDAY, MAY 21, 2026
summary: Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) today announced it will release its fourth quarter and full year financial results for the 2026 fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 after market close on Thursday, May 21. Lionsgate senior management will hold its analyst and investor conference call to discuss its fiscal 2026 financial results at 5:00 P.M. ET/2:00 P.M. PT on Thursday, May 21. Interested parties may listen to the live webcast by visiting the events page on the Lionsgate Investor relations website or via the following link . A full replay will be available starting Thursday evening, May 21, by clicking the same link. About Lionsgate: Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) is one of the world's leading standalone, pure play content companies.
